description: Returns CatchUI's ready-to-use implementation instructions for 1 to 6 UI patterns — what to build, where it sits, its states and the accessibility it needs — in English or Chinese, for pasting into an AI coding tool such as Claude Code or Cursor. Accepts ids, names or short descriptions.

language.description: Language of the prompts: "en" (English) or "zh" (简体中文).

patterns.description: 1 to 6 CatchUI pattern ids, names or short descriptions, e.g. ["tabs"] or ["search field", "filter chips", "pagination"].

name: get_implementation_prompt
title: Get implementation prompts
